text_block_list.text:
Wanting to recharge her energy for 
tomorrow, I took Buena Vista to an 
amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! So many happy voices...
choice_data_list:
Looks like they're having a parade over 
there!

Looks like they're having a parade over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Really? Well then, let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Nn... What a huge crowd. To think they're 
this popular...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Don't rush, it's better to go slowly— 
Ah...

At the end of Buena Vista's gaze... there 
was a young boy who had fallen to the 
ground, looking on the verge of tears.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Did she fall down...? Sorry, I'm gonna go 
check on her real quick.
choice_data_list: Ah, Buena—!

text_block_list.text:
I lost sight of her...! I tried to contact 
her, but the reception is terrible, 
probably because of the crowds...

"If we wait a little while, we should be 
able to get in touch. ...However—"
choice_data_list: (I wonder if Buena's okay...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll... wait here, okay?

When she lost her way and was about to be 
left all alone... she looked so lonely 
back then.
choice_data_list: ...Let's go look for it...!

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they couldn't have gone that far. 
If we search thoroughly, I know we'll...!

...Sweat poured from running all over the 
place. Even so, I desperately searched for 
her—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: (...! Is that—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ah... Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: Buena! Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Wait, Trainer, are YOU okay!? 
You're panting and out of breath...!!
choice_data_list: ...I thought you might be feeling lonely.
...I thought you might be feeling lonely.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
! ...Geez, you're worrying way too much. 
We only got separated for a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. ...I'm not a little kid anymore, 
you know.
choice_data_list:
...Wait, didn't you have a handkerchief 
just now?

...Wait, weren't you holding a 
handkerchief just now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list:
Because that's what I always used to do 
when holding back tears.

text_block_list.text:
—It had been that way ever since 
childhood.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
choice_data_list:
You got soaked in the rain... Are you 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: *Hic*... I-I'm fine...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Buu-chan... 'cuz... I don't just cry all 
the time...!
choice_data_list:
(...Clutching the handkerchief that 
tightly...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...You even remembered something like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I really can't hide anything from 
you, can I? ...Still, I was only a little 
anxious, really.

"...Compared to the old days, she has 
grown splendidly. She's no longer the 
spoiled child she once was."

Bringing smiles to lost children... I 
truly believe she has become a wonderful 
Umamusume. ...And yet—

"Just as you showed me that day. If you 
fear being alone even in the slightest—"
I want to be there by Buena Vista's side.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
Whenever you're lonely, lean on me like 
you used to.

Whenever you're lonely, lean on me like 
you used to.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ! ...Just like old times...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. ...Yeah. We've always been 
together, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Right? I really want to watch the 
parade together with you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But you know, getting lost is a little bit 
scary. ...So that's why—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want you to hold my hand. ...Is that... 
okay?
choice_data_list: That's not true... Here, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Thanks, Big Bro!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Thanks, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah! What an amazing dance... Everyone's 
clapping along and having fun.
choice_data_list: Should we clap along too?
Shall we clap along too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's true... Ah—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I guess I'll pass for now. ...Can we 
just keep watching like this for a little 
longer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"We're back already, huh... Ehehe, it 
really felt like a dream."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer-san. Thanks to you, I feel 
so much more energized.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could spend this time with you.

I'm glad I got to spend the same time with 
you.
I'll always have your back!
I'll always be here to help you!
Let's go out together again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer-san. Thanks to you, I feel 
so much more energized.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could spend this time with you.

I'm glad I got to spend the same time with 
you.
I'll always have your back!
I'll always be here to help you!
Let's go out together again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me too. ...Hehe, come to think of 
it, it's kind of strange, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Just like when we were little... Even now, 
we're always together.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Aha, those are powerful words. ...I'm 
really, really happy to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...We really have seen so many 
different sights together, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm with you, Trainer, we can 
go anywhere. I'm counting on you from now 
on too!
